model_free_checks.post_test_source_changes: Equivalent Result::and(completed) and relocation of the unchanged generate function before the test module. No fixture or inference parameter changes.

verdict.cause: The only completed group-1 request ignored the explicit Chinese target-language instruction and returned an English near-copy. The language validator rejected it and the runner stopped at first no progress.

single_trial_observations.limitation: Single-claim and trace/process observations describe this owned trial; no inference about unrelated historical experiments.

actual_request.validation_error: 纪要输出语言与选择不符，原话仍待整理
actual_request.interpretation: This was not a missing zh setting or an exhausted 440-token output cap. The actual sent object contained the Chinese requirement; grouping did not ensure the model obeyed it.

actual_response: REMEMBER THAT EVEN THOUGH MUSIC ON THE MAIN STAGES MAY HAVE FINISHED, THERE MAY BE SECTIONS OF THE FESTIVAL THAT WILL KEEP PLAYING MUSIC UNTIL LATE INTO THE NIGHT.

unreached_and_untested.meaning: The run stops before Chinese actor-group generation, assembly or a second frontier. It cannot qualify grouping, exact actor/name preservation or source6 handling. Empty final citations are the absence of an article, not evidence of correct final citation quality.

observed_costs.interpretation: Shorter failed work is not a resource gain. Only group 1 ran, no article was produced, cache/warmup conditions were uncontrolled, CPU is sampled lower-bound, and summed RSS can double-count shared pages.

next_hypothesis.status: Design hypothesis only; no implementation or new execution requested by this review.
next_hypothesis.observation: Even a separate English-only group with no name markers was copied in English under the correct Chinese request. Partitioning addresses cross-subject mixing but not target-language reliability.
next_hypothesis.hypothesis: Separate source-backed target-language evidence preparation from article composition. A typed translation result can remain keyed by source revision, target language and model, preserve original quote/name bindings, and be reused from cache; article assembly consumes validated target-language evidence instead of repeatedly asking one request to translate, compress, preserve qualifiers and bind actors simultaneously.
next_hypothesis.cost_constraint: Reuse existing valid translations first. Any newly required translation send must stay inside an explicitly frozen request budget; no hidden extra pass, prompt sweep, model substitution or per-group repair loop.
next_hypothesis.qualification_limit: This trial does not establish that the hypothesis works. Name fidelity, conditional meaning and source closure still require independent checks; the failed trial remains immutable.
